Bought fish from Pets at Home after following their staff’s advice. Every single fish died. When I complained, they reviewed CCTV, then told me their position was “unchanged” and that the customer is ultimately responsible—conveniently ignoring the fact their staff gave guidance in store.

No apology, no accountability, no concern for the animals that died. Just a corporate email closing the complaint and telling me to seek “external advice.” If their staff advice can’t be trusted and they take zero responsibility when it goes wrong, they shouldn’t be selling live animals.

Avoid.

I drop her off to the friendly staff, then go for a walk around the shopping centre, always picking up a treat from the main pets at home store downstairs! Loads to choose from!

We sadly had to say goodbye to our beloved 20-year-old Siamese cat, George, yesterday 💔. It was an incredibly hard day for our family, but we are so grateful to the team at Colton Vets for their compassion and care throughout.
Our vet, Ben Rosindale, was absolutely wonderful. What a kind and respectful man. Although the procedure wasn’t straightforward due to how poorly George was, Ben did everything he could to ensure it was handled with dignity. He gave us time, space, and treated both George and our family with the utmost care.
We were all there to say goodbye, and while we were understandably very upset, Ben, the lady on reception, and the two nurses helped make an incredibly difficult experience that bit easier. Their kindness and professionalism meant so much to us.
Thank you all so very much. You made a heartbreaking time a little less painful, and we will always remember that 🥰.
